patterns.note: Content sections frequently use an asymmetrical two-column layout, pairing a prominent image or graphic on one side with descriptive text and a call-to-action on the other.
The site employs a high-contrast color scheme, primarily using black and white, punctuated by a vibrant, almost neon pink (#FF2B85) for accents and calls-to-action.
Full-bleed hero sections feature large, bold white text overlaid on a dark-tinted background image or video, creating a strong visual impact and ensuring text readability.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling, providing persistent access to links and CTAs.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the large heading text scrolls at a slightly slower rate than its background image, creating a sense of depth.
A horizontal scrolling carousel is used for displaying news or press releases, allowing users to browse multiple cards within a confined space.

technique_notes: Implement a fixed header navigation that remains at the top of the viewport on scroll, ensuring constant access to site navigation.

Create a hero section with a full-bleed background video or image, applying a dark gradient overlay to enhance text contrast. Achieve a subtle parallax effect by making the overlaying text scroll at a slightly slower rate than the background.
Utilize a JavaScript library (like Swiper.js) to build a horizontally scrollable card section for dynamic content, where each card can contain an image, text, and a label.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (H1 ~4-5x body) with clear hierarchy, paired with a readable, slightly condensed sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons and cards feature slightly rounded corners, typically 4-8px).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within content blocks, creating an airy feel, especially in the hero and main content areas.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a vibrant, almost neon pink as a primary accent color against a high-contrast black and white palette immediately grabs attention, making the CTAs and key information pop. The full-bleed video heroes with subtle parallax also contribute to a dynamic and engaging first impression.
